title: Xatolarsiz yozish: tahrir va korrektura
goal_uz: Dars oxirida siz o‘z matningizni aniq ketma-ketlikdagi nazorat ro‘yxati bilan tahrir qilasiz, C2 darajasidagi nozik xatolarni topasiz, tinish belgilarini to‘g‘ri qo‘llaysiz va matnni ma’nosini yo‘qotmasdan uchdan bir qismgacha qisqartira olasiz.

vocab.uz: ikki mustaqil gapni faqat vergul bilan ulash xatosi
omofon (bir xil aytiladigan, har xil yoziladigan so‘z)

scenes.title: Mukammal matn sari
board: Error-Free Writing: Editing and Proofreading
(Xatolarsiz yozish: tahrir va korrektura)
Checklist · Subtle errors · Punctuation · Concision
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! Oldingi darsda tabiiy nutq oqimi ustida ishladik: ritm, kuchsiz shakllar va bog‘lanish. Bugun qog‘ozga qaytamiz. Dars oxirida siz matnni tartibli nazorat ro‘yxati bilan tahrir qilasiz, eng ilg‘or yozuvchilar ham qiladigan nozik xatolarni topasiz, tinish belgilarini ishonch bilan qo‘llaysiz va matnni ixchamlashtirasiz.
scenes.say: Good writing is rewriting. Today you’ll learn to read your own work like a ruthless editor, and to catch the small errors that quietly cost you marks and credibility.
scenes.say_uz: Yaxshi yozish — qayta yozish. Bugun siz o‘z ishingizni ayovsiz muharrirdek o‘qishni va sizga sezdirmay ball hamda ishonchni yo‘qotadigan mayda xatolarni ushlashni o‘rganasiz.

scenes.title: Tahrir va korrektura farqi
board: 1) Editing: content & structure (katta rasm)
2) Line editing: sentences & word choice
3) Proofreading: spelling, punctuation, typos
Work top-down: big → small
scenes.say_native: Tahrir va korrektura bir narsa emas. Tahrir — mazmun va tuzilma bilan ishlash: fikr aniqmi, paragraflar mantiqiy tartibdami? Keyin jumla darajasidagi tahrir: so‘z tanlovi, grammatika, uslub. Eng oxirida korrektura: imlo, tinish belgilari, tasodifiy xatolar. Tartib muhim: yuqoridan pastga. Keyin o‘chirib tashlanadigan paragrafdagi vergulni tuzatishga vaqt sarflashning ma’nosi yo‘q.
scenes.say: Edit from the top down. First ask whether the argument works, then whether the sentences work, and only at the very end whether every comma is in place.
scenes.say_uz: Yuqoridan pastga tahrir qiling. Avval dalil ishlayaptimi, keyin jumlalar ishlayaptimi, va faqat eng oxirida har bir vergul joyidami, deb so‘rang.

scenes.title: Katta rasm nazorati
board: Is the main point clear in the first paragraph?
One idea per paragraph + a topic sentence?
Does each paragraph follow logically?
Does the conclusion answer the question?
scenes.say_native: Birinchi o‘tishda faqat to‘rt savol bering. Asosiy fikr birinchi paragrafda aniq aytilganmi? Har bir paragrafda bitta g‘oya va uni ochadigan mavzu jumlasi bormi? Paragraflar mantiqiy ketma-ketlikda va o‘tish so‘zlari bilan bog‘langanmi? Xulosa savolga javob beradimi? Foydali usul: har paragrafning birinchi jumlasini ketma-ket o‘qing. Agar shundan matnning qisqacha mazmuni chiqsa, tuzilma ishlayapti.
scenes.say: Here’s a quick test: read only the first sentence of every paragraph. If those sentences tell the whole story, your structure is sound.
scenes.say_uz: Mana tezkor sinov: har bir paragrafning faqat birinchi jumlasini o‘qing. Agar shu jumlalar butun voqeani aytib bersa, tuzilmangiz mustahkam.

scenes.title: Korrektura usullari
board: Leave it overnight (masofa oling)
Read it aloud, slowly
Change the font or print it out
One pass per error type + a personal error log
scenes.say_native: O‘z matningizdagi xatoni ko‘rish qiyin, chunki miyangiz nima yozmoqchi bo‘lganingizni eslaydi va bo‘shliqni o‘zi to‘ldiradi. Shuning uchun masofa yarating: matnni bir kecha qoldiring, shriftni o‘zgartiring yoki chop eting. Ovoz chiqarib, sekin o‘qing: quloq ko‘z o‘tkazib yuborganni ushlaydi. Har bir o‘tishda bitta xato turini qidiring. Va shaxsiy xatolar daftarini yuriting: ko‘pchilikning eng ko‘p takrorlanadigan xatolari besh-oltitadan oshmaydi.
scenes.say: Your brain knows what you meant to write, so it reads that instead of what’s actually on the page. Distance, a new font and your own voice break the spell.
scenes.say_uz: Miyangiz nima yozmoqchi bo‘lganingizni biladi, shuning uchun sahifada haqiqatda yozilganni emas, o‘shani o‘qiydi. Masofa, yangi shrift va o‘z ovozingiz bu sehrni buzadi.

scenes.title: Spellchekerga ishonish
board: ✗ Their going too the meeting at for.
✓ They’re going to the meeting at four.
Every word is a real word → no red line!
scenes.say_native: Eng xavfli ishonch: “kompyuter xatoni tagiga chizadi”. Ekrandagi birinchi jumlada to‘rtta xato bor, lekin har bir so‘z haqiqiy so‘z, shuning uchun imlo tekshiruvchi jim turadi. “Their” o‘rniga “they’re”, “too” o‘rniga “to”, “for” o‘rniga “four”. Avtomatik vositalar foydali, lekin ular yakuniy hakam emas. Bunday xatolarni faqat sekin, diqqat bilan o‘qish ushlaydi.
scenes.say: They’re going to the meeting at four. Spellcheckers catch words that don’t exist; they rarely catch real words in the wrong place.
scenes.say_uz: Ular soat to‘rtdagi yig‘ilishga ketyapti. Imlo tekshiruvchilar mavjud bo‘lmagan so‘zlarni ushlaydi, noto‘g‘ri joydagi haqiqiy so‘zlarni esa kamdan-kam.

scenes.title: Spellcheker ko‘rmaydigan xatolar
board: 1) Its been a long weak.
2) The affect on staff was huge.
3) We should of planned better.
4) Whose responsible for the budget?
scenes.say_native: Mashq. To‘rt jumlaning har birida imlo tekshiruvchi ko‘rmaydigan xato bor. Ularni toping va tuzating. Uchinchi jumlaga alohida e’tibor bering: bu xato aynan oldingi darsda o‘rgangan kuchsiz shakllardan kelib chiqadi. Qanday qilib? Har birini o‘zingizga ovoz chiqarib o‘qing: ba’zan quloq xatoni ko‘zdan oldin sezadi.
scenes.say: Find the error in each sentence. Every word is spelled correctly, which is exactly the problem.
scenes.say_uz: Har bir jumladagi xatoni toping. Har bir so‘z to‘g‘ri yozilgan, muammo ham aynan shunda.

scenes.title: Javoblar: omofonlar
board: 1) It’s been a long week.
2) The effect on staff was huge.
3) We should have planned better.
4) Who’s responsible for the budget?
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: “it’s” — “it is” yoki “it has” qisqartmasi, apostrof bilan; “weak” — kuchsiz, “week” — hafta. Ikkinchi: “effect” odatda ot, “affect” odatda fe’l. Uchinchi: “should have” nutqda kuchsiz shaklda “ʃʊdəv” deb aytiladi va “should of” deb eshitiladi. Lekin yozuvda faqat “should have” yoki “should’ve”. To‘rtinchi: “who’s” — “who is”, “whose” — kimning.
scenes.say: It’s been a long week. The effect on staff was huge. We should have planned better. Who’s responsible for the budget? Say should’ve, but never write should of.
scenes.say_uz: Uzun hafta bo‘ldi. Xodimlarga ta’sir juda katta bo‘ldi. Yaxshiroq rejalashtirishimiz kerak edi. Byudjetga kim mas’ul? Should’ve deb ayting, lekin hech qachon should of deb yozmang.

scenes.title: Chalkash juftliklar
board: practice (n) / practise (v) — BrE; AmE: practice (both)
licence (n) / license (v) — BrE
principle (rule) / principal (main, head)
stationary (not moving) / stationery (paper, pens)
scenes.say_native: Yana bir guruh chalkash juftliklar. Britaniya inglizchasida “practice” — ot, “practise” — fe’l; Amerikada ikkalasi ham “practice”. “Licence” va “license” ham Britaniyada xuddi shunday ajraladi. “Principle” — tamoyil, “principal” — asosiy yoki maktab direktori. “Stationary” — harakatsiz, “stationery” — kanselyariya buyumlari. Bularni eslab qolish uchun shaxsiy xatolar daftaringizga yozing va misol qo‘shing.
scenes.say: I need more practice, so I practise every day. As a matter of principle, the principal never buys cheap stationery.
scenes.say_uz: Menga ko‘proq mashq kerak, shuning uchun har kuni mashq qilaman. Tamoyilga ko‘ra, direktor hech qachon arzon kanselyariya buyumlarini sotib olmaydi.

scenes.title: Britaniya va Amerika imlosi
board: colour / color · centre / center
travelled / traveled · programme / program
organise or organize (BrE both) / organize (AmE)
Rule: choose one variety and be consistent
scenes.say_native: Britaniya va Amerika imlosi o‘rtasida muntazam farqlar bor: “colour” va “color”, “centre” va “center”, “travelled” va “traveled”. Britaniyada “organise” ham, “organize” ham ishlatiladi, Amerikada esa “-ize”. Britaniyada televizion dastur “programme”, kompyuter dasturi esa ikkala variantda ham “program”. Imtihonda ikkala variant ham to‘g‘ri, lekin bitta matn ichida aralashtirmang. Bu korrektura ro‘yxatingizdagi alohida band bo‘lsin.
scenes.say: Neither spelling is wrong, but mixing them in one text looks careless. Pick British or American at the start, and set your spellchecker to match.
scenes.say_uz: Hech bir imlo noto‘g‘ri emas, lekin ularni bitta matnda aralashtirish beparvo ko‘rinadi. Boshidanoq britaniya yoki amerika variantini tanlang va imlo tekshiruvchini shunga sozlang.

scenes.title: C2 darajasida artikllar
board: ✗ The life is short. ✓ Life is short.
general idea → zero article
the + specific: the life of Navoi
in hospital (BrE) / in the hospital (AmE)
scenes.say_native: O‘zbek tilida artikl yo‘q, shuning uchun C2 darajasida ham xatolarning katta qismi shu yerda. Umumiy tushunchalar haqida gapirganda artikl qo‘yilmaydi: “Life is short”, “Technology changes society”. Aniq narsa haqida bo‘lsa, “the” kerak: “the life of Navoi”, “the technology we use at work”. Ba’zi farqlar variantga bog‘liq: Britaniyada “in hospital”, Amerikada “in the hospital”. Korrekturada har bir otga qarab, “umumiymi yoki aniqmi?” deb so‘rang.
scenes.say: Life is short, but the life of a fruit fly is shorter still. Technology changes society; the technology we use at work changes every year.
scenes.say_uz: Hayot qisqa, lekin meva pashshasining hayoti undan ham qisqaroq. Texnologiya jamiyatni o‘zgartiradi; ishda foydalanadigan texnologiyamiz esa har yili o‘zgaradi.

scenes.title: Ega va kesim moslashuvi
board: The number of students has risen.
A number of students have complained.
Each of the reports was checked.
Neither the manager nor the staff were told.
scenes.say_native: Uzun jumlalarda ega va kesim moslashuvi oson buziladi. “The number of…” birlik oladi, chunki ega — “number”. “A number of…” esa “ko‘plab” degani va ko‘plik oladi. “Each of the reports” birlikda: “was”. “Neither… nor…” da kesim yaqinroq egaga moslashadi: “nor the staff were”. Britaniyada “the team are” ham uchraydi, Amerikada esa odatda “the team is”. Tekshirishda egani toping va oradagi so‘zlarni xayolan olib tashlang.
scenes.say: The number of students has risen, and a number of them have complained. Strip out the words in between, find the real subject, and the verb will look after itself.
scenes.say_uz: Talabalar soni oshdi va ularning bir qanchasi shikoyat qildi. Oradagi so‘zlarni olib tashlang, haqiqiy egani toping, shunda kesim o‘z-o‘zidan to‘g‘ri bo‘ladi.

scenes.title: Osilib qolgan aniqlovchi
board: ✗ Walking into the office, the computer was broken.
✓ Walking into the office, I found the computer was broken.
The -ing phrase must describe the subject
scenes.say_native: Bu C2 darajasidagi eng nozik xatolardan biri. Gap boshidagi “-ing” yoki “-ed” iborasi jumlaning egasiga tegishli bo‘lishi shart. “Walking into the office, the computer was broken” da grammatik jihatdan kompyuter ofisga kirib kelgan bo‘lib chiqadi. O‘zbek tilida “-ib” bilan bunday erkinlik ko‘proq: “Ofisga kirib, kompyuter buzilganini ko‘rdim” deyish mumkin. Inglizchada esa ega aniq turishi kerak: “I found…”.
scenes.say: Walking into the office, I found the computer was broken. Ask yourself who is doing the walking, and make sure that person is the subject.
scenes.say_uz: Ofisga kirib, kompyuter buzilganini ko‘rdim. O‘zingizdan kim yurayotganini so‘rang va o‘sha odam ega ekanini tekshiring.

scenes.title: Parallel tuzilma
board: ✗ She likes reading, to swim and cycling.
✓ She likes reading, swimming and cycling.
✗ not only cheap but also it is fast
✓ not only cheap but also fast
scenes.say_native: Ro‘yxat yoki juft bog‘lovchidagi elementlar bir xil grammatik shaklda bo‘lishi kerak. “Reading, to swim and cycling” — ikki gerundiy orasida infinitiv bor; to‘g‘risi uchala gerundiy. “Not only… but also…” dan keyin ham bir xil turkum keladi: “not only cheap but also fast”. Parallel tuzilma matnni ritmik va o‘qishga oson qiladi, buzilgani esa darhol ko‘zga tashlanadi. Ro‘yxatlarni korrektura qilganda har elementning birinchi so‘ziga qarang.
scenes.say: The new system is not only cheaper but also faster. It saves time, reduces errors and keeps everyone informed. Same shape, same rhythm.
scenes.say_uz: Yangi tizim nafaqat arzonroq, balki tezroq ham. U vaqtni tejaydi, xatolarni kamaytiradi va hammani xabardor qilib turadi. Bir xil shakl, bir xil ritm.

scenes.title: Nozik so‘z tanlovi
board: fewer (countable) / less (uncountable)
comprise = consist of (✗ comprise of)
despite / in spite of (✗ despite of)
information, advice, equipment (no plural)
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta keng tarqalgan nozik xato. Sanaladigan otlar bilan “fewer”: “fewer people”; sanalmaydigan bilan “less”: “less time”. “Comprise” o‘zi “tarkib topmoq” degani, shuning uchun “of” kerak emas: “The UK comprises four countries”. “Despite” dan keyin “of” qo‘yilmaydi, “in spite of” da esa kerak. Va “information”, “advice”, “equipment” inglizchada sanalmaydi, rus va o‘zbek tillaridagidan farqli, ko‘plik qo‘shimchasi olmaydi.
scenes.say: Fewer people, less time. The UK comprises four countries. Despite the rain, or in spite of the rain. And some useful advice, never advices.
scenes.say_uz: Kamroq odam, kamroq vaqt. Buyuk Britaniya to‘rt mamlakatdan iborat. Yomg‘irga qaramay. Va bir oz foydali maslahat, hech qachon maslahatlar emas.

scenes.title: Ona tilidan ko‘chgan xatolar
board: ✗ Despite of the delay…  ✓ Despite the delay…
✗ many useful informations  ✓ a lot of useful information
✗ The life in the city is expensive.  ✓ Life in the city…
scenes.say_native: Bu xatolarning umumiy ildizi bor: ona tilimiz va rus tilining tuzilmasi. “Despite of” — “-ga qaramay” va “несмотря на” ning ta’siri. “Informations” — o‘zbekcha “ma’lumotlar” ko‘plik shaklida ishlatilgani uchun. “The life in the city” — artiklni qayerga qo‘yishni sezmaslik. Bularning hammasi grammatik qoidani bilmaslikdan emas, odatdan kelib chiqadi. Shuning uchun ularni xatolar daftaringizga yozib, har korrekturada alohida qidiring.
scenes.say: Despite the delay, we found a lot of useful information. Life in the city is expensive. Clean, simple and correct.
scenes.say_uz: Kechikishga qaramay, ko‘plab foydali ma’lumot topdik. Shahardagi hayot qimmat. Toza, sodda va to‘g‘ri.

scenes.title: Nozik xatolarni tuzating
board: 1) The number of applicants have doubled.
2) Having finished the report, the printer broke.
3) Despite of the delay, we finished on time.
4) She gave me many useful advices.
5) The plan is cheap, quick and it is effective.
scenes.say_native: Besh jumla, har birida bittadan nozik xato: moslashuv, osilib qolgan ibora, ortiqcha predlog, sanalmaydigan ot va parallel tuzilma. Har birini toping, tuzating va qaysi turga kirishini ayting. Ikkinchi jumlani tuzatishning bir nechta yo‘li bor. Tuzatgandan keyin har jumlani ovoz chiqarib o‘qing va tabiiy eshitilishini tekshiring.
scenes.say: Five sentences, five subtle errors. Fix each one and name the type of error.
scenes.say_uz: Besh jumla, beshta nozik xato. Har birini tuzating va xato turini ayting.

scenes.title: Javoblar: nozik xatolar
board: 1) The number of applicants has doubled.
2) Having finished the report, I found the printer had broken.
3) Despite the delay, …
4) She gave me a lot of useful advice.
5) The plan is cheap, quick and effective.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: “The number… has doubled”, moslashuv. Ikkinchi: osilib qolgan ibora; “Having finished the report, I found the printer had broken” yoki “After I had finished the report, the printer broke”. Uchinchi: “Despite the delay”. To‘rtinchi: “a lot of useful advice” yoki “some useful advice”. Beshinchi: “cheap, quick and effective”, parallel tuzilma. Beshtasini ham topgan bo‘lsangiz, muharrir ko‘zingiz ishlayapti.
scenes.say: The number of applicants has doubled. Having finished the report, I found the printer had broken. Despite the delay, we finished on time. She gave me a lot of useful advice. The plan is cheap, quick and effective.
scenes.say_uz: Arizachilar soni ikki baravar oshdi. Hisobotni tugatgach, printer buzilib qolganini ko‘rdim. Kechikishga qaramay, vaqtida tugatdik. U menga ko‘p foydali maslahat berdi. Reja arzon, tez va samarali.

scenes.title: Tinglash: muharrir fikri
board: Listening 1: Sara (editor) and Tom (writer)
A report draft before the deadline
Listen for: three errors and one compliment
scenes.say_native: Endi suhbatni tinglang. Muharrir Sara yozuvchi Tom bilan uning hisobot qoralamasini muhokama qilyapti. Uchta xatoni eshitishga harakat qiling: qaysi so‘z yoki tuzilma noto‘g‘ri va qanday tuzatiladi. Shuningdek, Sara matnning nimasini maqtaganini va Tomga juma kunigacha nima qilishni maslahat berganini kuzating.
scenes.say: Sara: Your argument’s strong, but there are a few slips. Tom: Go on, be brutal. Sara: Paragraph two says ‘less people use cars’. People are countable, so it’s fewer. Tom: Fair. Sara: Then ‘Looking at the figures, the trend is clear.’ The trend isn’t looking at anything. Try ‘Looking at the figures, we can see a clear trend.’ Tom: Guilty. Sara: And on page three, ‘its a significant change’ needs an apostrophe. Otherwise, it’s clear and well organised. One slow read before Friday.
scenes.say_uz: Sara: Dalilingiz kuchli, lekin bir nechta xato bor. Tom: Davom eting, ayamang. Sara: Ikkinchi paragrafda “less people use cars” deyilgan. Odamlar sanaladi, shuning uchun fewer. Tom: To‘g‘ri. Sara: Keyin “Raqamlarga qarab, tendensiya aniq”. Tendensiya hech narsaga qaramayapti. “Raqamlarga qarab, aniq tendensiyani ko‘ramiz” deb yozing. Tom: Aybdorman. Sara: Va uchinchi sahifada “its a significant change” ga apostrof kerak. Aks holda matn aniq va yaxshi tuzilgan. Jumagacha bir marta sekin o‘qib chiqing.

scenes.title: Suhbatni tushunish
board: 1) What are the three errors?
2) Name the type of each error.
3) What does Sara praise?
4) What does she advise Tom to do?
scenes.say_native: Savollarga javob bering. Sara qaysi uchta xatoni topdi va ular qaysi turdagi xatolar? U matnning nimasini maqtadi? Tomga juma kunigacha nima qilishni maslahat berdi? Javoblarni bugungi atamalar bilan ayting: moslashuv, osilib qolgan ibora, omofon va hokazo.
scenes.say: What are the three errors, and what type is each one? What does Sara praise? And what does she tell Tom to do before Friday?
scenes.say_uz: Uchta xato nima va har biri qaysi turga kiradi? Sara nimani maqtaydi? Va u Tomga jumagacha nima qilishni aytadi?

scenes.title: Javoblar: muharrir suhbati
board: 1) less → fewer (countable noun)
2) Looking at the figures, the trend… → dangling modifier
3) its → it’s (apostrophe)
Praise: clear, well organised · Advice: one slow read-through
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi xato: “less people” — sanaladigan ot bilan “fewer” kerak. Ikkinchisi: “Looking at the figures, the trend is clear” — osilib qolgan ibora, tuzatilgani: “we can see a clear trend”. Uchinchisi: “its” o‘rniga “it’s”, ya’ni “it is”. Sara matnni aniq va yaxshi tuzilgan deb maqtadi va jumagacha bir marta sekin o‘qib chiqishni maslahat berdi. E’tibor bering: yaxshi muharrir avval tuzilmani, keyin mayda xatolarni baholaydi.
scenes.say: Fewer, not less. We can see a clear trend. It’s, with an apostrophe. And the best advice of all: one slow read-through before the deadline.
scenes.say_uz: Less emas, fewer. Aniq tendensiyani ko‘ramiz. Apostrof bilan it’s. Va eng yaxshi maslahat: muddatdan oldin bir marta sekin o‘qib chiqish.

scenes.title: Vergul bilan ulash xatosi
board: ✗ The results were good, we celebrated.
✓ The results were good. We celebrated.
✓ The results were good; we celebrated.
✓ The results were good, so we celebrated.
scenes.say_native: Comma splice — ikki mustaqil gapni faqat vergul bilan ulash. Rus va o‘zbek tillarida bu ko‘pincha normal, ingliz tilida esa rasmiy yozuvda xato hisoblanadi. Uch yechim bor: nuqta qo‘yish, nuqtali vergul qo‘yish yoki vergul bilan birga bog‘lovchi qo‘shish: “and”, “but”, “so”. E’tibor bering, “however” bog‘lovchi emas: “The results were good, however we…” ham xato. To‘g‘risi: “The results were good; however, we…”.
scenes.say: The results were good, so we celebrated. The results were good; however, we stayed cautious. Two complete sentences need more than a comma between them.
scenes.say_uz: Natijalar yaxshi edi, shuning uchun nishonladik. Natijalar yaxshi edi; ammo biz ehtiyotkor bo‘lib qoldik. Ikki to‘liq gap orasiga verguldan ko‘ra kuchliroq narsa kerak.

scenes.title: That dan oldin vergul yo‘q
board: ✗ I think, that he is right.
✓ I think (that) he is right.
Russian: Я думаю, что… → English: no comma
✗ He said, that… ✓ He said that…
scenes.say_native: Rus tilida “что” dan oldin vergul majburiy: “Я думаю, что он прав”. Ko‘p o‘quvchilar bu odatni inglizchaga ko‘chiradi: “I think, that he is right”. Ingliz tilida “that” bilan boshlanadigan to‘ldiruvchi ergash gapdan oldin vergul qo‘yilmaydi. Bundan tashqari, so‘zlashuvda va norasmiy yozuvda “that” ko‘pincha tushirib qoldiriladi: “I think he’s right”. Bu xato juda tez ko‘zga tashlanadi, shuning uchun “that” so‘zini qidirib, oldidagi vergulni tekshiring.
scenes.say: I think he’s right. She said that the figures were wrong. We agreed that it was too late. No commas, and no pauses in your voice either.
scenes.say_uz: Menimcha, u haq. U raqamlar noto‘g‘ri ekanini aytdi. Juda kech ekaniga kelishdik. Vergul yo‘q, ovozingizda ham pauza yo‘q.

scenes.title: Aniqlovchi ergash gaplar
board: My brother who lives in London… (I have several)
My brother, who lives in London, … (I have one)
Non-defining: commas + which / who (never that)
Defining: no commas; that or which / who
scenes.say_native: Vergul ma’noni o‘zgartirishi mumkin. “My brother who lives in London is a doctor” — vergulsiz, demak bir nechta akam bor va Londonda yashaydiganini ajratib ko‘rsatyapman. “My brother, who lives in London, is a doctor” — vergul bilan, ya’ni akam bitta, Londonda yashashi qo‘shimcha ma’lumot. Vergulli ergash gapda “that” ishlatilmaydi, faqat “which” yoki “who”. O‘zbek tilida bunday farq vergul bilan emas, kontekst bilan bildiriladi.
scenes.say: The report, which was published in May, caused a storm. The report that was published in May caused a storm. Same words, different stories about how many reports there were.
scenes.say_uz: May oyida e’lon qilingan hisobot, aytgancha, bo‘ron qo‘zg‘adi. Aynan may oyida e’lon qilingan hisobot bo‘ron qo‘zg‘adi. Bir xil so‘zlar, lekin nechta hisobot bo‘lgani haqida turli hikoyalar.

scenes.title: Ikki nuqta, nuqtali vergul, apostrof
board: Colon after a complete clause: We need one thing: time.
Semicolon: two linked clauses; complex lists
the company’s profits · the companies’ profits
scenes.say_native: Ikki nuqta to‘liq gapdan keyin keladi va izoh yoki ro‘yxatni ochadi: “We need one thing: time”. Rasmiy yozuvda “The reasons are: cost and time” kabi to‘liq bo‘lmagan gapdan keyin ikki nuqta qo‘ymagan ma’qul. Nuqtali vergul ikki bog‘liq gapni yoki ichida vergul bor murakkab ro‘yxatni ajratadi. Apostrof: birlikda “the company’s”, ko‘plikda “the companies’”. Oddiy ko‘plikda apostrof yo‘q: “the 1990s”, “CDs”.
scenes.say: We need one thing: time. The company’s profits rose; the other companies’ profits fell. And the nineteen-nineties needs no apostrophe at all.
scenes.say_uz: Bizga bitta narsa kerak: vaqt. Kompaniyaning foydasi oshdi; boshqa kompaniyalarning foydasi tushdi. To‘qsoninchi yillar esa umuman apostrofga muhtoj emas.

scenes.title: Tinish belgilaridagi tuzoqlar
board: ✗ I believe, that this is true.
✗ Sales rose, however profits fell.
✗ the 1990’s · the childrens’ books
✓ Sales rose; however, profits fell. · the children’s books
scenes.say_native: Uchta tipik xato. Birinchi: “that” dan oldin vergul, rus tili ta’siri. Ikkinchi: “however” ni bog‘lovchidek ishlatish: “Sales rose, however profits fell”; to‘g‘risi nuqtali vergul yoki nuqta bilan: “Sales rose; however, profits fell”. Uchinchi: apostrof chalkashligi: “children” allaqachon ko‘plik, shuning uchun “the children’s books”, “childrens’” emas. Bu uchtasini xatolar daftaringizga yozing va har bir matnda alohida qidiring.
scenes.say: Sales rose; however, profits fell. The children’s books are on the top shelf. Small marks, big difference.
scenes.say_uz: Sotuvlar oshdi; ammo foyda kamaydi. Bolalar kitoblari yuqori javonda. Kichik belgilar, katta farq.

scenes.title: Tinish belgilarini qo‘ying
board: 1) The deadline was moved we still finished early
2) The results which were published in May were wrong (only one set)
3) There are three options cut costs raise prices or close the branch
4) Both companies profits fell in the 1990s
scenes.say_native: To‘rt jumlaga tinish belgilarini qo‘ying. Birinchisida ikki mustaqil gap bor. Ikkinchisida faqat bitta natijalar to‘plami bor, demak ergash gap qo‘shimcha ma’lumot. Uchinchisida to‘liq gapdan keyin ro‘yxat keladi. To‘rtinchisida ikki kompaniyaning foydasi haqida gap ketyapti. Yozing va o‘zingizni tekshiring.
scenes.say: Punctuate the four sentences. Think: two clauses, extra information, a list, and a plural possessive.
scenes.say_uz: To‘rt jumlaga tinish belgisi qo‘ying. O‘ylang: ikki gap, qo‘shimcha ma’lumot, ro‘yxat va ko‘plikdagi qaratqich.

scenes.title: Javoblar: tinish belgilari
board: 1) The deadline was moved; we still finished early.
2) The results, which were published in May, were wrong.
3) There are three options: cut costs, raise prices or close the branch.
4) Both companies’ profits fell in the 1990s.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: nuqtali vergul yoki nuqta; “but” qo‘shsangiz, vergul ham bo‘ladi: “was moved, but we still finished early”. Ikkinchi: ikki vergul bilan, chunki bu qo‘shimcha ma’lumot. Uchinchi: to‘liq gapdan keyin ikki nuqta, so‘ng vergullar. Britaniyada “or” dan oldin vergul odatda qo‘yilmaydi, Amerikada esa ko‘pincha qo‘yiladi. To‘rtinchi: “companies’” — ko‘plikdan keyin apostrof, “1990s” — apostrofsiz.
scenes.say: The deadline was moved; we still finished early. The results, which were published in May, were wrong. There are three options: cut costs, raise prices or close the branch.
scenes.say_uz: Muddat o‘zgartirildi; baribir erta tugatdik. May oyida e’lon qilingan natijalar noto‘g‘ri edi. Uchta variant bor: xarajatni qisqartirish, narxni oshirish yoki filialni yopish.

scenes.title: Ixchamlik: ortiqcha so‘zlar
board: due to the fact that → because
in order to → to · at this point in time → now
end result → result · past history → history
It is important to note that… → (delete)
scenes.say_native: Endi to‘rtinchi mavzu: ixchamlik. Ingliz tilida yaxshi yozilgan matn — har bir so‘z o‘z ishini bajaradigan matn. Birinchi nishon: uzun iboralar. “Due to the fact that” — shunchaki “because”, “in order to” — “to”, “at this point in time” — “now”. Ikkinchi nishon: takror juftliklar: “end result”, “past history”, “future plans”, “each and every”. Uchinchi: hech narsa demaydigan kirish iboralari: “It is important to note that”. Ularni o‘chiring, fikr kuchliroq chiqadi.
scenes.say: Because, not due to the fact that. To, not in order to. Now, not at this point in time. Every word you cut makes the remaining words louder.
scenes.say_uz: Due to the fact that emas, because. In order to emas, to. At this point in time emas, now. Siz qisqartirgan har bir so‘z qolgan so‘zlarni balandroq yangratadi.

scenes.title: Otlarni fe’lga qaytaring
board: We made a decision to carry out an investigation. → We decided to investigate.
There are many people who believe… → Many people believe…
The report was written by the team. → The team wrote the report.
scenes.say_native: Matnni og‘irlashtiradigan yana bir odat — nominalizatsiya, ya’ni harakatni otga aylantirish: “make a decision to carry out an investigation”. Fe’lga qaytaring: “decided to investigate”. “There are many people who…” kabi boshlanishlar ham ortiqcha: “Many people believe”. Harakatni kim qilgani muhim bo‘lsa, aniq nisbatni tanlang. Ilmiy matnda majhul nisbat o‘rinli, lekin uni odat sifatida emas, sabab bilan ishlating.
scenes.say: We decided to investigate. Many people believe the opposite. The team wrote the report. Shorter sentences, stronger verbs, and nobody hiding behind the passive.
scenes.say_uz: Tekshirishga qaror qildik. Ko‘p odamlar buning aksiga ishonadi. Hisobotni jamoa yozdi. Qisqaroq jumlalar, kuchliroq fe’llar va hech kim majhul nisbat orqasiga yashirinmaydi.

scenes.title: Takror juftliklarni toping
board: 1) We need to plan ahead for our future plans.
2) The end result was completely finished on time.
3) Each and every member must attend.
4) Let me briefly summarise in a few words.
scenes.say_native: Qisqa mashq. Har bir jumlada bir xil ma’noni ikki marta beradigan so‘zlar bor. Ularni toping va ortiqchasini o‘chiring. Masalan, “plan ahead” va “future plans” birgalikda “kelajak uchun oldindan reja” degan takrorni beradi. Har jumlani qisqartirgach, ovoz chiqarib o‘qing: ma’no o‘zgarmaganini tekshiring.
scenes.say: Each sentence says something twice. Find the redundancy and cut it.
scenes.say_uz: Har bir jumla nimanidir ikki marta aytadi. Takrorni toping va olib tashlang.

scenes.title: Javoblar: takrorlar
board: 1) We need to plan for the future.
2) The result was finished on time. / It was finished on time.
3) Every member must attend.
4) Let me briefly summarise.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: “plan ahead” va “future plans” takror; “We need to plan for the future” yetarli. Ikkinchi: “end result” — shunchaki “result”, “completely finished” — “finished”. Uchinchi: “each and every” — “every”. To‘rtinchi: “briefly” va “in a few words” bir xil ma’no; bittasi kifoya. Bu juftliklar nutqda tabiiy bo‘lishi mumkin, lekin yozma matnda ular faqat joy egallaydi.
scenes.say: We need to plan for the future. It was finished on time. Every member must attend. Let me briefly summarise.
scenes.say_uz: Kelajakni rejalashtirishimiz kerak. U vaqtida tugatildi. Har bir a’zo qatnashishi shart. Qisqacha xulosa qilay.

scenes.title: Rasmiyatchilik tuzog‘i
board: Ushbu masala yuzasidan tegishli choralar ko‘rilishi maqsadga muvofiq.
✗ It is considered expedient that appropriate measures be taken with regard to this issue.
✓ We should act on this.
scenes.say_native: O‘zbek idoraviy uslubida ot, “-lik” qo‘shimchasi va majhul nisbat ko‘p: “Ushbu masala yuzasidan tegishli choralar ko‘rilishi maqsadga muvofiq”. Uni so‘zma-so‘z o‘girsangiz, o‘n to‘rt so‘zli, hech kim javobgar bo‘lmagan inglizcha jumla chiqadi. Ingliz ish yozuvida bu og‘ir va hatto qochishga o‘xshab qabul qilinadi. Kim, nima qilishini aniq ayting: “We should act on this” yoki undan ham aniqroq, harakatni nomlang.
scenes.say: We should act on this. Better still: we should review the contract by Friday. Say who does what, and when.
scenes.say_uz: Bu borada choralar ko‘rishimiz kerak. Yana ham yaxshisi: shartnomani jumagacha qayta ko‘rib chiqishimiz kerak. Kim, nima va qachon qilishini ayting.

scenes.title: Qisqartiring
board: 1) Due to the fact that the train was late, we missed the start.
2) At this point in time, we are not in a position to make a decision.
3) There are many students who make the same mistake.
4) The committee carried out an investigation into the causes of the failure.
scenes.say_native: To‘rt jumlani ma’nosini yo‘qotmasdan qisqartiring. Ortiqcha iboralarni almashtiring, “there are… who” tuzilmasini olib tashlang, otni fe’lga qaytaring. So‘zlarni sanang: har jumla kamida uchdan biriga qisqarishi kerak. Har qanday qisqartirishdan keyin ma’no o‘zgarmaganini albatta tekshiring.
scenes.say: Cut each sentence by at least a third, without losing any meaning.
scenes.say_uz: Har bir jumlani ma’nosini yo‘qotmasdan kamida uchdan biriga qisqartiring.

scenes.title: Javoblar: ixcham variantlar
board: 1) Because the train was late, we missed the start.
2) We can’t decide yet.
3) Many students make the same mistake.
4) The committee investigated the causes of the failure.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: “Because the train was late, we missed the start”. Ikkinchi: o‘n to‘rt so‘zdan to‘rtta: “We can’t decide yet”; rasmiyroq: “We cannot decide yet”. Uchinchi: “Many students make the same mistake”. To‘rtinchi: “The committee investigated the causes of the failure” yoki “investigated why it failed”. Ko‘rib turibsizki, ma’no to‘liq saqlandi, faqat shovqin yo‘qoldi.
scenes.say: Because the train was late, we missed the start. We can’t decide yet. Many students make the same mistake. The committee investigated the causes of the failure.
scenes.say_uz: Poyezd kechikkani uchun boshlanishiga ulgurmadik. Hozircha qaror qila olmaymiz. Ko‘p talabalar bir xil xato qiladi. Qo‘mita muvaffaqiyatsizlik sabablarini tekshirdi.

scenes.title: Tinglash: emailni ixchamlash
board: Listening 2: Priya and Jamshid
Editing an email before sending it
Listen for: what is cut and why
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi suhbat. Priya muhim xatni yuborishdan oldin hamkasbi Jamshiddan tekshirib berishni so‘raydi. Jamshid qaysi jumlalarni qisqartirishni taklif qiladi va nima uchun? Qaysi ma’lumot qo‘shiladi? Oxirida xat qanchaga qisqardi? Sabablarga diqqat qiling.
scenes.say: Priya: Can you check this email? Jamshid: Sure. ‘I am writing in order to inform you of the fact that the meeting has been postponed to a later date.’ Too long: one fact, twenty-one words. Try ‘The meeting has been postponed.’ Priya: They need the new date. Jamshid: So give it: ‘The meeting has moved to Thursday 14 May.’ And ‘questions or queries’ says the same thing twice. Try ‘Let me know if you have any questions.’ Priya: Half the length! Jamshid: And far more likely to be read.
scenes.say_uz: Priya: Bu xatni tekshirib bera olasizmi? Jamshid: Albatta. “Yig‘ilish keyinroq sanaga ko‘chirilgani haqidagi fakt to‘g‘risida sizni xabardor qilish maqsadida yozyapman.” Juda uzun: bitta fakt, yigirma bir so‘z. “Yig‘ilish ko‘chirildi” deb ko‘ring. Priya: Ularga yangi sana kerak. Jamshid: Unda uni bering: “Yig‘ilish 14-may, payshanbaga ko‘chirildi.” “Savol yoki so‘rovlar” esa bir narsani ikki marta aytadi. “Savollaringiz bo‘lsa, xabar bering” deb yozing. Priya: Yarmiga qisqardi! Jamshid: Va o‘qilish ehtimoli ancha oshdi.

scenes.title: Suhbatni tahlil qiling
board: 1) Why is the first sentence a problem?
2) What information does Jamshid add?
3) What is wrong with ‘questions or queries’?
4) What is the final result?
scenes.say_native: To‘rt savol. Birinchi jumlaning muammosi nima edi? Jamshid qanday ma’lumot qo‘shishni taklif qildi va nega? “Questions or queries” iborasining nimasi noto‘g‘ri? Natijada xat qanday o‘zgardi? E’tibor bering: ixchamlik faqat qisqartirish emas, ba’zan kerakli narsani qo‘shish ham.
scenes.say: Why is the first sentence a problem? What does Jamshid add? What’s wrong with questions or queries? And what’s the final result?
scenes.say_uz: Birinchi jumlaning muammosi nima? Jamshid nima qo‘shadi? Questions or queries ning nimasi noto‘g‘ri? Va yakuniy natija qanday?

scenes.title: Javoblar: email tahriri
board: 1) 21 words for one fact (in order to, the fact that)
2) the new date: Thursday 14 May
3) redundancy: two words, one meaning
4) half the length, more likely to be read
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: bitta fakt uchun yigirma bir so‘z, “in order to” va “the fact that” kabi ortiqcha iboralar bilan. Ikkinchi: yangi sana, payshanba, 14-may; chunki o‘quvchiga aynan shu kerak. Ixcham bo‘lish noaniq bo‘lish degani emas. Uchinchi: “questions” va “queries” bir ma’noni beradi, bu takror. To‘rtinchi: xat yarmiga qisqardi va o‘qilish ehtimoli oshdi.
scenes.say: Concise doesn’t mean vague. Jamshid cut the padding and added the one detail the reader actually needed: the new date.
scenes.say_uz: Ixcham degani noaniq degani emas. Jamshid ortiqcha so‘zlarni olib tashladi va o‘quvchiga haqiqatan kerak bo‘lgan bitta tafsilotni qo‘shdi: yangi sanani.

scenes.title: To‘rt o‘tishli tizim
board: Pass 1: structure & argument
Pass 2: concision (cut 10–20%)
Pass 3: grammar & your error log
Pass 4: read aloud for punctuation & typos
scenes.say_native: Endi hammasini bitta tizimga yig‘amiz. Birinchi o‘tish: tuzilma va dalil. Ikkinchi o‘tish: ixchamlik; ko‘pincha matnning o‘ndan bir yoki beshdan bir qismini olib tashlash mumkin. Uchinchi o‘tish: grammatika va shaxsiy xatolar daftaringizdagi har bir band. To‘rtinchi o‘tish: ovoz chiqarib o‘qish, tinish belgilari va tasodifiy xatolar uchun. Imtihonda vaqt kam bo‘lsa, kamida uchinchi va to‘rtinchi o‘tishni qisqa shaklda bajaring.
scenes.say: Four passes, four questions. Does it work? Is it lean? Is it correct? Does it sound right aloud? In an exam, save at least five minutes for the last two.
scenes.say_uz: To‘rt o‘tish, to‘rt savol. Ishlayaptimi? Ixchammi? To‘g‘rimi? Ovoz chiqarib o‘qiganda to‘g‘ri eshitiladimi? Imtihonda oxirgi ikkitasi uchun kamida besh daqiqa qoldiring.

scenes.title: Yakuniy topshiriq: paragrafni tahrir qiling
board: In my opinion, the online learning have many advantages. Firstly it saves time, students don’t need to travel.
Secondly, due to the fact that lessons are recorded, students can watch them again, which is useful for there revision.
Despite of this, some informations can be lost.
scenes.say_native: Yakuniy topshiriq. Ekrandagi paragrafda kamida yettita xato bor: artikl, moslashuv, vergul bilan ulash, ortiqcha ibora, omofon, ortiqcha predlog va sanalmaydigan ot. To‘rt o‘tishli tizimdan foydalanib, paragrafni to‘liq tahrir qiling. Keyin ovoz chiqarib o‘qing va namuna bilan solishtiring.
scenes.say: Edit the paragraph. There are at least seven errors. Use all four passes.
scenes.say_uz: Paragrafni tahrir qiling. Kamida yettita xato bor. To‘rt o‘tishning hammasidan foydalaning.

scenes.title: Namuna tahrir
board: Online learning has many advantages. Firstly, it saves time: students don’t need to travel.
Secondly, because lessons are recorded, students can watch them again, which helps their revision.
Despite this, some information can be lost.
scenes.say_native: Namuna. “The online learning have” — umumiy tushuncha, artiklsiz va birlik: “Online learning has”. “In my opinion” ham olib tashlandi, chunki bu sizning inshoingiz. “Firstly it saves time, students…” — vergul bilan ulash; ikki nuqta qo‘ydik. “Due to the fact that” — “because”. “There” — “their”. “Despite of” — “Despite”. “Some informations” — “some information”. Yana qaysi xatolarni topdingiz?
scenes.say: Online learning has many advantages. Firstly, it saves time: students don’t need to travel. Secondly, because lessons are recorded, students can watch them again, which helps their revision. Despite this, some information can be lost.
scenes.say_uz: Onlayn ta’limning ko‘p afzalliklari bor. Birinchidan, u vaqtni tejaydi: talabalar yo‘l yurishi shart emas. Ikkinchidan, darslar yozib olingani uchun talabalar ularni qayta ko‘ra oladi, bu takrorlashga yordam beradi. Shunga qaramay, ba’zi ma’lumotlar yo‘qolishi mumkin.

scenes.title: Dars xulosasi
board: Checklist: structure → concision → grammar → aloud
Subtle errors: agreement, dangling modifiers, parallelism
Punctuation: no comma splices, no comma before that
Concision: cut padding, prefer verbs
scenes.say_native: Xulosa. Birinchi: tahrir yuqoridan pastga, to‘rt o‘tishda, shaxsiy xatolar daftari bilan. Ikkinchi: nozik xatolar — artikllar, moslashuv, osilib qolgan iboralar, parallel tuzilma va omofonlar. Uchinchi: tinish belgilari — vergul bilan ulash yo‘q, “that” dan oldin vergul yo‘q, ergash gaplarda vergul ma’noni o‘zgartiradi. To‘rtinchi: ixchamlik — ortiqcha iboralarni qisqartiring, otlarni fe’lga qaytaring, lekin kerakli tafsilotni saqlang.
scenes.say: Structure, concision, grammar, sound. Edit in that order, keep your error log close, and your writing will read as if it were effortless.
scenes.say_uz: Tuzilma, ixchamlik, grammatika, tovush. Shu tartibda tahrir qiling, xatolar daftarini yoningizda saqlang, shunda yozuvingiz go‘yo hech qiyinchiliksiz yozilgandek o‘qiladi.

scenes.title: Uy vazifasi
board: Homework: edit a 300-word text to perfection
Use the four passes + your error log
Success: cut 15%+, zero grammar or punctuation errors
scenes.say_native: Uy vazifasi: o‘zingiz yozgan yoki ilgari yozgan 300 so‘zli matnni oling va uni to‘rt o‘tishli tizim bilan mukammal holga keltiring. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: matn kamida 15 foizga qisqargan, ma’no saqlangan, grammatik va tinish belgisi xatosi qolmagan, topgan xatolaringizning har biri daftaringizga yozilgan. Keyingi darsda gapirish bo‘yicha to‘liq sinov imtihonini topshiramiz.
scenes.say: Your homework: take a three-hundred-word text and edit it to perfection. Cut at least fifteen per cent, fix every error, and log what you find.
scenes.say_uz: Uy vazifangiz: uch yuz so‘zli matnni oling va uni mukammal holga keltiring. Kamida o‘n besh foiz qisqartiring, har bir xatoni tuzating va topganlaringizni daftarga yozing.

homework_uz: O‘zingiz yozgan 300 so‘zli matnni to‘rt o‘tishli tizim (tuzilma, ixchamlik, grammatika, ovoz chiqarib o‘qish) bilan mukammal holga keltiring. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: matn kamida 15 foizga qisqargan, ma’no saqlangan, grammatik va tinish belgisi xatolari qolmagan, topilgan har bir xato shaxsiy xatolar daftariga yozilgan.

options: We should of had left earlier.
quiz.why_uz: “Should of” — kuchsiz shakl “should’ve” ning noto‘g‘ri yozilishi; to‘g‘risi “should have”.

quiz.q: Choose the correct verb: 'The number of complaints ___ risen sharply.'
Which sentence has a dangling modifier?
options: Opening the door, I saw a strange light.
Opening the door, a strange light appeared.
When I opened the door, I saw a light.
I opened the door and saw a light.
quiz.why_uz: Eshikni yorug‘lik ochmagan: “-ing” iborasi egaga tegishli emas.

options: Despite of the rain, we went out.
Despite the rain, we went out.
In spite the rain, we went out.
Despite to the rain, we went out.
quiz.why_uz: “Despite” dan keyin “of” yo‘q; “in spite of” da esa bor.

options: I think, that she is right.
The results were good, we celebrated.
quiz.why_uz: “However” bog‘lovchi emas: oldidan nuqtali vergul, keyin vergul.

quiz.q: 'My sister, who lives in Bukhara, is a teacher.' This suggests:
options: my sister is not a teacher
quiz.why_uz: Vergulli ergash gap qo‘shimcha ma’lumot: opam/singlim bitta.
Ko‘plikdagi “companies” dan keyin apostrof; oddiy ko‘plikda apostrof yo‘q.

quiz.q: The most concise version of 'due to the fact that' is:
options: in view of the fact that

quiz.q: Which word is uncountable in English?
quiz.why_uz: “Advice” sanalmaydi: some advice, a piece of advice.

quiz.q: In British English, which is correct?
options: I need to practice more. (BrE verb)
